questions.question: What happens when constructors call other constructors?
What keyword in Java calls another constructor?
questions.explanation: This() invokes another constructor in the same class.

questions.question: What keyword applied to a constructor prevents external instantiation of a class?
questions.explanation: A private constructor cannot be called from outside the class, enabling singletons and factory-only creation.

questions.question: What Java method runs during garbage collection?
questions.explanation: finalize() performs cleanup before garbage collection. It has been deprecated since Java 9; prefer try-with-resources or java.lang.ref.Cleaner.

questions.question: What order are constructors called in inheritance?
questions.explanation: Parent constructors execute before child constructors.

questions.question: What order are destructors called in inheritance?
questions.explanation: Child destructors execute before parent destructors.

questions.question: What constructor accepts one parameter for conversion?
questions.explanation: Conversion constructors enable implicit type conversion.

questions.question: What C++11 constructor steals resources from temporary objects?
questions.explanation: Move constructors transfer ownership instead of copying.

questions.question: What runs before a C++ constructor body to initialize members?
questions.explanation: The member initializer list initializes fields before the body executes.

questions.question: What function calls the parent class constructor in Python?
questions.explanation: Super() delegates initialization to the parent class.

questions.question: What Java interface enables try-with-resources cleanup?
questions.explanation: AutoCloseable objects close automatically when the try block ends.

questions.question: What does the Java compiler insert when you write no constructor?
questions.explanation: The compiler generates a no-arg default constructor automatically.
